auto.ordnance.name: Ordnance Core
auto.ordnance.desc: Every 5s, a shell hits the biggest crowd (4.7 m)

auto.soulburst.name: Soul Burst
auto.soulburst.desc: Every 12 kills, a burst around you (5.6 m)

auto.orbit.name: Orbit Blades
auto.orbit.desc: 4 blades spin around you, cutting what they touch

auto.drone.name: Drone Buddy
auto.drone.desc: A drone shoots the nearest enemy 4 times a second

auto.frostnova.name: Frost Nova
auto.frostnova.desc: Every 5s, a frost ring (6 m) slows enemies 55%

auto.firetrail.name: Fire Trail
auto.firetrail.desc: Walking leaves fire that burns 28 damage a second

auto.boomerang.name: Boomerang
auto.boomerang.desc: 3 boomerangs cut out and back through every enemy

auto.airstrike.name: Airstrike
auto.airstrike.desc: Every 7s, 5 bombs fall on enemies on screen

auto.toxic.name: Toxic Cloud
auto.toxic.desc: Every 5s, a poison cloud (3.4 m) lands on the biggest crowd

auto.gravity.name: Gravity Well
auto.gravity.desc: Every 7s, a vortex pulls enemies in 5 m together, then bursts

auto.thorns.name: Thorn Aura
auto.thorns.desc: Enemies touching you take 22 damage a second and are knocked back

auto.turret.name: Sentry Turret
auto.turret.desc: Every 10s, drop 2 turrets that fire 4.6 shots a second for 6s

auto.meteor.name: Meteor
auto.meteor.desc: Every 11s, a meteor (3.8 m) crushes the biggest crowd and leaves fire

auto.stormcloud.name: Storm Cloud
auto.stormcloud.desc: A storm cloud follows you and strikes an enemy every 0.6s

auto.iceshards.name: Ice Shards
auto.iceshards.desc: Every 3s, 10 ice shards burst out, piercing and slowing

auto.flameburst.name: Flame Burst
auto.flameburst.desc: Every 4s, a fire cone (6.2 m) burns the nearest crowd

auto.landmine.name: Landmines
auto.landmine.desc: Every 2.2 m walked, drop a mine that blows up under enemies

auto.axe.name: Spinning Axe
auto.axe.desc: Every 2.2s, hurl 3 spinning axes through the crowd

auto.wardog.name: War Dog
auto.wardog.desc: Two war dogs bite the nearest enemy 1.8 times a second

auto.stomp.name: Ground Stomp
auto.stomp.desc: Every 4s, a stomp throws back every enemy within 5 m

auto.timewarp.name: Time Warp
auto.timewarp.desc: Every 16s, every enemy moves at half speed for 4s

evo.thunderstorm.name: Thunderstorm
evo.thunderstorm.desc: Chain Lightning every 2s through 6 enemies, harder

evo.carpetbomb.name: Carpet Bomb
evo.carpetbomb.desc: Ordnance drops a line of 3 shells

evo.absolutezero.name: Absolute Zero
evo.absolutezero.desc: Frost Nova freezes enemies solid; frozen take +50%

evo.squadron.name: Drone Squadron
evo.squadron.desc: 3 drones; their kills can drop coins

evo.reaper.name: Reaper
evo.reaper.desc: Kills can release a soul burst

evo.plague.name: Plague
evo.plague.desc: Clouds follow the crowd; poisoned kills spread poison

evo.singularity.name: Singularity
evo.singularity.desc: A vortex that never closes drifts through the horde

evo.meteorstorm.name: Meteor Storm
evo.meteorstorm.desc: Five meteors fall in a line

evo.ironmaiden.name: Iron Maiden
evo.ironmaiden.desc: Thorns hit twice as hard; a broken shield throws a spike wave

evo.supercell.name: Supercell
evo.supercell.desc: A bigger storm: every strike is critical and chains to 3

evo.blizzard.name: Blizzard
evo.blizzard.desc: Ice shards circle you nonstop and freeze what they cut

evo.dragonbreath.name: Dragon Breath
evo.dragonbreath.desc: A fire jet sweeps around you without stopping

evo.minefield.name: Minefield
evo.minefield.desc: Cluster mines: every blast sets off the mines around it

evo.axestorm.name: Axe Storm
evo.axestorm.desc: Four axes circle you, then fly out through the crowd

evo.alphapack.name: Alpha Pack
evo.alphapack.desc: Three war dogs; every bite heals you

evo.earthquake.name: Earthquake
evo.earthquake.desc: The stomp cracks the ground and stuns everything in it

evo.timestop.name: Time Stop
evo.timestop.desc: Every enemy freezes solid for 2 seconds
